# Prove the Claim, Then Earn the Ritual: A Supplement Campaign Built for Japan

The four tests from the market-entry framework were built for exactly this problem — and nowhere do they bite harder than in ingestibles. In supplements, **the claim is the product**: the customer swallows a promise she cannot verify at the shelf. So this campaign is designed test-first, creative-second.
